# thousandeyes_alert_suppression_window (Data Source)

Retrieve alert suppression window.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Code generated by tfpfgen. DO NOT EDIT.

data "thousandeyes_alert_suppression_window" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Unique ID of the alert suppression window. Named `id` per the import convention; the wire field stays alertSuppressionWindowId.
- `name` (String) Name of the alert suppression window.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `duration` (Number) Duration in seconds the suppression window is active.
- `end_repeat` (Attributes) End repeat options. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--end_repeat))
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Set to `false` for `disabled`, `true` for `enabled`.
- `repeat` (Attributes) Repeat options. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--repeat))
- `start_date` (String) The date/time when the alert suppression window starts (ISO date-time format).
- `status` (String) Indicates the current status of the suppression window.
- `tests` (Attributes Set) List of tests assigned to the alert suppression window. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tests))

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--end_repeat"></a>
### Nested Schema for `end_repeat`

Read-Only:

- `count` (Number) End repeat after number of occurrences, only valid with count type option.
- `date` (String) End repeat after specific date, only valid with date type option (ISO date format).
- `type` (String) End repeat options type.


<a id="nestedatt--repeat"></a>
### Nested Schema for `repeat`

Read-Only:

- `days_of_week` (Set of String)
- `interval_length` (Number) Number of `intervalTypes` to wait before reactivating the alert suppression window.
- `interval_type` (String) Repeat options interval type
- `type` (String) Repeat options type.


<a id="nestedatt--tests"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tests`

Read-Only:

- `alerts_enabled` (Boolean) Indicates if alerts are enabled.
- `created_by` (String) User that created the test.
- `created_date` (String) UTC created date (ISO date-time format).
- `description` (String) A description of the test.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Test is enabled.
- `interval` (Number) Interval between test runs in seconds.
- `live_share` (Boolean) Indicates if the test is shared with the account group.
- `modified_by` (String) User that modified the test.
- `modified_date` (String) UTC last modification date (ISO date-time format).
- `saved_event` (Boolean) Indicates if the test is a saved event. **Note**: **Saved Events** are now called **Private Snapshots** in the user interface. This change does not affect API.
- `test_id` (String) Each test is assigned an unique ID; this is used to access test information and results from other endpoints.
- `test_name` (String) The name of the test. Test name must be unique.
- `type` (String) This is a read only value, as test type is implicit in the test creation url.
